Legacy status flags is_deleted/active/enabled/allowed_for_display must not be collapsed into one status without producer, consumer and restore proof.
Legacy content_data typed shape contains schedule, discussion visibility, assignment attachments, resource list, calendar and video metadata beyond current generic vNext scalar content fields.
Legacy per-class content order requires verify section+delivery correspondence and safe concurrent reorder; current staging omits enforced unique sequence per delivery.
Legacy generated unique keys use LOWER(TRIM) and optional abbreviated title; vNext lower(name) index is not yet equivalent; slug/parent-course/title metadata absent.
V163 retired legacy content types before source oracle; do not re-add retired formats from older snapshots without product review.
Tenant consistency across membership, delivery, lesson and created-by actor is not guaranteed by independent FKs alone.
